name: OmaGames
author: davidsmorais
description: Single bar entry that launches and manages every installed game plugin. Scans installed manifests for Games/Fun categories (plus game/arcade tags and aliases) so new games show up automatically; enable/disable any game's top-bar icon from one place.

barWidget.description: Game launcher — one bar icon for every installed game plugin.

schema.label: Always include (IDs)
schema.description: Comma-separated plugin IDs to always list, even if they are not detected as games.

schema.label: Never include (IDs)
schema.description: Comma-separated plugin IDs to hide from the launcher.
